title: pv-* change/fix .metadata.json
description: Mutable per-change state stored at {workFolder}/changes/{state}/{xxxx}/.metadata.json, alongside description.md / plan.md / history.md. A dotfile: it only exists once a change has at least one flag (or, from the risk plan, a risk value). 'Missing file' / 'missing field' / '[]' all mean 'no flags'. todo/ folders NEVER carry this file. The 'flags' enum is the canonical catalogue of framework flags: adding a flag = one enum value here + its icon/label in pv-status's FLAG_* maps, nothing else.

flags.description: Active status flags for this change. Order is not significant; consumers normalise to a fixed paint order (priority before workinprogress).

flagsLastModified.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last effective change to 'flags' (any add or remove). A single global timestamp, not one per flag. set-metadata.py writes it; no consumer reads it yet (reserved for future 'sort by recent activity' / 'stale flag' features).

risk.description: Declared here for the 'move risk to .metadata.json' plan (change 2). This plan (flags) never writes it; set-metadata.py preserves it untouched if another writer added it.
